## Updates:
- GP#1950: Added onboarding guide to launcher main interface & control layout editor (by @MovTery)
- GP#1956: Refactored existing easter egg effect layer, added easter egg effects for multiple holidays (by @MovTery)
- GP#1957: Added compatibility with lwjgl3ify & use MioLauncherWrapper (by @MovTery)
- GP#1963: Card grid supports free placement, allowing vertical gaps between cards (by @MovTery)

## Refactors:
- GP#1972: Optimized main interface card repositioning logic, card drag displacement changed to chain-style door-opening semantics (by @MovTery)
- GP#1974: Refactored tablet main interface layout (by @MovTery)

## Changes:
- GP#1973: Adjusted launcher update dialog style (by @MovTery)

## Fixes:
- GP#1964: SDL message box message mistakenly set as title causing incomplete error info display (by @MovTery)
- GP#1971: Fixed Cleanroom input method input being misidentified as key presses (by @MovTery)

## 更新：
- GP#1950：启动器主界面 & 控制布局编辑器 加入新手引导 (by @MovTery)
- GP#1956：重构现有彩蛋效果层，为多个节日添加彩蛋效果 (by @MovTery)
- GP#1957：兼容 lwjgl3ify & 使用 MioLauncherWrapper (by @MovTery)
- GP#1963：卡片网格支持自由摆放，允许卡片间纵向留空 (by @MovTery)


## 重构：
- GP#1972：优化主界面卡片换位逻辑，卡片拖动让位改为链式开门语义 (by @MovTery)
- GP#1974：重构平板下主界面的布局 (by @MovTery)


## 调整：
- GP#1973：调整启动器更新对话框的样式 (by @MovTery)


## 修复：
- GP#1964：SDL 消息框 message 误设为标题导致错误信息显示不全 (by @MovTery)
- GP#1971：修复 Cleanroom 输入法输入被误判为按键 (by @MovTery)
